---
title: "2 — Run connectivity from network"
format: html
---

## Prerequisites

Run `0_setup.qmd` and `1_net_with_dams_from_network.qmd` in the same R session.

## Objects needed

`out`, `paths`

## R source

`R/connectivity_from_network.R`

## Creates

`out_conn`

Run connectivity over the blended dam network from notebook 1.

```{r}
#| label: params
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("R/connectivity_from_network.R")

threshold <- 250
threshold_downstream_km <- threshold
threshold_upstream_km <- threshold
threshold_cascade_km <- threshold
```

```{r}
#| label: run-connectivity

out_conn <- connectivity_from_network(
  net_with_dams = out$net_with_dams,
  threshold_downstream_km = threshold_downstream_km,
  threshold_upstream_km = threshold_upstream_km,
  threshold_cascade_km = threshold_cascade_km
)
```

```{r}
#| label: save-output

out_conn_path <- file.path(
  paths$processed,
  paste0("reach_df_", threshold, "_GIS_v2.rds")
)
saveRDS(out_conn, out_conn_path)
message("Saved connectivity output to: ", out_conn_path)
```
